messages:
kai: Heads-up — please hold merges for my PR #15422 (landing db-migration guardrail). We hit a flaky integration test and there's a weekend deploy freeze starting 18:00 UTC. Don’t merge until I get a clean CI and one more approver. @mira @ben :eyes:

mira: Copy. ETA on rerun / fixes?

kai: Hoping to get a clean rerun in 20–30m. Failing test looks like a timing flake in TestKVLease. I pushed a tiny retry patch but keeping PR blocked until we confirm CI.

ben: I can rerun the flaky job once you push. Last run failed on mac-matrix, flaky networking error we've seen before.

ci-bot: PR #15422 — CI status: failing (integration/macos-matrix), last run: 1779991000. Rerun available: use `/ci rerun pr 15422 macos-matrix`

kai: Thanks — running rerun now: `/ci rerun pr 15422 macos-matrix`

sam: I can watch the rerun and kick off a full integration if this one passes. If it flakes again I’ll queue a cross-region rerun to isolate infra.

ben: FYI release freeze window is 18:00 UTC Sat -> 06:00 UTC Mon. If this isn't green before freeze we should gate and land after. No emergency exemptions unless it's a hotfix.

release-bot: Reminder: deploy freeze scheduled. Please do not merge PRs that may touch runtime DB migrations during freeze.

kai: Rerun finished — macos-matrix is green, linux-integration still running. Pasting relevant log snippet: ```
--- PASS: TestKVLease (0.12s)
--- PASS: TestKVLeaseRetry (0.09s)
```

mira: Great. I can give approver +1 pending linux-integration green. Please tag me when final job completes. :thumbsup:

ben: I’ll wait for the linux job. If it hangs we should abort and reschedule post-freeze. Don't want to risk a rollback during freeze.

ci-bot: PR #15422 — linux-integration: running (started 1779991400)

alex: I’ll give a second approver once linux passes. If it’s green before 17:45 UTC we can still squeeze it. Otherwise we hold to Monday.

kai: Noted. If green, I’ll merge and monitor; if not, I’ll rebase and requeue first thing Mon. Thanks everyone for fast eyes. @eng-releases please hold merges on anything touching `migrations/` until Monday unless explicitly cleared. :pray:
